Flow.description:
add logic in proposal to approval
Removed the Draft-exit, Proposal→Approval, and Ready-to-close task-comparison/restart logic (Compare_Task_From_Case_For_Opportunity, _approval, and _In_Ready_to_Close, plus their supporting decisions and the Passport Sanction Ready to Close filter). This logic is fully superseded by DMT_OpportunityTriggerHandler.restartApprovalTasksOnOpportunityResubmission, which reads its tracked-field list from DMT_RendererFactory instead of a hardcoded field list here, so it never needs a flow update again when tracked fields change. Save Date Proposal still runs unconditionally on every Draft→Proposal transition, unchanged.
